ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are two vertical lines a and b, marked as parallel lines with arrows in the same direction; slanted line d intersects a and b respectively. At the intersection of line a and d, ∠14 is located on the right side of line a and below d; at the intersection of line b and d, ∠10 is located on the left side of line b and above d.
